name: command-center teaching edition
_comment_include: The command-center shell: shared toolkit, platform doors, gates, BMAD module, operator docs, and root routing/config. Projects and session history are deliberately empty. The paired project skeleton remains its own maintained repository and is cloned later by smh-new-project.
_comment_exclude: Active bindings, machine-local state, source-only export machinery, and domain-specific incident doors do not belong in a fresh shell. An exclude naming a path that does not exist is harmless, so these are pruned only when the thing is RETIRED, never merely absent: `.claude/worktrees` is absent from a worktree checkout and present in the lobby the export actually runs from, and `.claude/scratchpad-root` is a machine-local pointer that would leak a real path if it came back unguarded. Both stay.
_comment_emptyDirs: Top-level shape only; no project names, personal notes, BMAD output, or session history cross the export boundary.
_comment_lineTransforms: Path-scoped catalog pruning for assets deliberately absent from a fresh shell. Every anchor is required so source drift fails the export instead of reviving a ghost.

_comment_substitutions: Case-sensitive content substitutions run before whole-file transforms. The final leak scan is case-insensitive and checks both content and paths.

_comment_overlay: Teaching-only surfaces that do not exist in the source tree, ADDED at the export path named by `path` from the file named by `from` (relative to this manifest's folder). Four properties, each pinned by a case in test_teaching_edition.py: (1) a declared overlay whose `from` is missing FAILS the export - a tutor that silently stops shipping is the defect this mechanism exists to end; (2) a file under overlay/ that no entry declares FAILS the export - an undeclared file must never reach a public repo; (3) an overlay may not land on a path the copy pass already wrote - that is a collision and the export refuses rather than guessing which wins; (4) overlays are written BEFORE `substitutions` and BEFORE the leak scan, never after. Property 4 is the load-bearing one: copy-last is the natural implementation and it is a hole straight through the only guard this export has. Property 3 is what replaces copy-last as the protection against being overwritten. `.agents/workflows/*` is deliberately absent - SCC-394 retired that surface and the export must not revive it.
_comment_transforms: Whole-file replacements for files that DO exist in the source tree. A target that does not exist belongs in `overlay` instead - `.training-mode` and `.agents/jira.conf.example` moved there when they left the lobby.
